Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: high-end game main-menu concept refinement, one full widescreen image, not a contact sheet. Input image 1 is the exact selected edit target.
Make ONE SLIGHT, elegant variation of this chosen rich crimson-and-black polished ground under a very shallow clear water film. This is fine tuning of the approved image, not a new art direction. Preserve the clean liquid-like black swirls embedded in the red floor unless the specific change below modifies them. 
CHANGE FOR THIS VARIANT: Keep water and floor close to the reference but make 3-4 extremely shallow concentric rings spreading from the feet slightly more readable. They fade naturally within about a metre. No splash, foam, raised liquid, magic circles or glow.
LOCK ALL OTHER FEATURES: same 16:9 canvas, camera perspective and horizon; same black void; same grey faceless articulated mannequin on the right with exactly the same silhouette, pose, size and placement; same realistic neutral white overhead lighting on the mannequin. Same menu at left, exact typeface, scale, spacing and placement. Exactly these five labels once each: CONTINUE, NEW GAME, LOAD GAME, SETTINGS, QUIT. Same thin violet selected underline. No game title, logo, caption, numbers or new decoration.
The water is clear and about 1cm over a solid smooth floor: ground fully readable, soles barely submerged, exposed ankles, no deep lake. Red comes from the ground pigment, not red illumination. The image must remain beautiful and polished with precise antialiasing and natural material rendering. No dirt, mud, rubble, coarse rock, gore, blood splashes, cracks, gold veins, tiles, new scenery, stars, constellation lines or vertical light beam. Do not change the UI or character to express the variation.
